en: An illustrated postcard view of a waterfront promenade in Port Said, with a quay on the left lined with moored boats and a sailing ship, and a street on the right bordered by multi‑story colonial buildings with balconies and shop awnings. In the foreground stands an ornate fountain or monument with a figure on top, surrounded by pedestrians in late‑19th‑century attire and a horse‑drawn carriage. The sky shows a soft sunset. The caption at the bottom reads "PORT SAID, Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee." and there is also a faint website watermark across the lower right.
